# syncwheel

> Deterministic Git maintenance for PR stacks, draft stacks, integration branches, and multi-agent
> repositories — several pull requests built and published from one checkout, without a worktree per
> branch.

Journal mode is the plan-first single-branch alternative for safe allowlisted
snapshots, exact-lease publication, and an optional Linux systemd user timer.

## Start Here

- README: https://github.com/NestDevLab/syncwheel#readme

## Install Commands

```bash
uv tool install "git+https://github.com/NestDevLab/syncwheel"
syncwheel self status
agentwheel install github:NestDevLab/syncwheel --adapter codex --local --skill syncwheel
```
